topic: Wilder Penfield & Edwin Boldrey (1937) Cortical Homunculus Awake Stimulation Mapping & Gordon et al. (2023) Somato-Cognitive Action Network (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Evan Gordon and Nico Dosenbach's 2023 precision fMRI discovery revealing that Penfield's classic primary motor strip is interrupted by three whole-body Somato-Cognitive Action Network (SCAN) planning hubs wired to prefrontal cortex.
